rows.jyutping: A tau3 ming4 dou6 m4 gau3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that a material or a set of decisions lacks transparency.

example.english: The opacity of the decision-making is too high because this policy change was poorly explained.
example.traditional: 呢次改政策冇交代清楚，決策透明度唔夠。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 goi2 zing3 caak3 mou5 gaau1 doi6 cing1 co2 kyut3 caak3 tau3 ming4 dou6 m4 gau3

rows.note: Use this technical noun for the measured optical opacity of a material, rather than the everyday construction.

example.english: This glass has high opacity, so it is not suitable for a window.
example.traditional: 呢塊玻璃嘅不透明度太高，唔適合做窗。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 bo1 lei4 ge3 bat1 tau3 ming4 dou6 taai3 gou1 m4 sik1 hap6 zou6 coeng1
